description: Defines the SaslResponseContext class which manages information related to the SASL handshake in an AMQP protocol implementation, including mechanisms, certificates, and connection details.

classes.name: SaslResponseContext
classes.description: A final class that extends MapBasedExecutionContext, encapsulating SASL handshake details such as mechanism, certificates, and connection.

methods.name: forMechanismPlain
methods.description: Creates a SaslResponseContext for the PLAIN SASL mechanism with provided connection and response fields.

methods.name: forMechanismExternal
methods.description: Creates a SaslResponseContext for the EXTERNAL SASL mechanism with provided connection and peer certificates.

methods.name: getPeerCertificateChain
methods.description: Returns the client certificate chain, or null if none.

methods.name: getSaslResponseFields
methods.description: Returns the SASL response fields (authzid, authcid, pwd) if PLAIN mechanism is used, otherwise null.

methods.name: getRemoteMechanism
methods.description: Returns the SASL mechanism used by the remote peer.

methods.name: getProtonConnection
methods.description: Returns the ProtonConnection associated with the SASL handshake.
